structured_output.summary:
Fixed: a race reset during the countdown (pause, then RESTART RACE) now replays the slide-in entry. Before, `reset()` called `enter(true)` while the entry flag was still set, so the guards in `race-ui.ts` and `hud.ts` made it do nothing and the panels never slid in for the new race.

Changes:
- `src/ui/race-ui.ts` `enter()`: the guard now only skips repeat `enter(false)` calls (`if (!on && !entering) return`), so every `enter(true)` from `reset()` goes through to the HUD and touch layers.
- New `restartClass(el, className, on)` in `src/ui/dom.ts`: removes the class and, when `on` is true, reads `offsetWidth` to force a style flush before adding the class back, so the CSS animation starts over.
- `src/ui/hud.ts` `enter()`: drops its own `entering` guard and flag and uses `restartClass`.
- `src/ui/touch-controls.ts` `enter()`: uses `restartClass` instead of `classList.toggle`.

At GO, `enter(false)` still removes the class once, so a resume never replays the entry. Nothing changes for a first reset or a reset after GO.

New test: `tests/ui/hud-entry-restart.test.ts`, the verifier's test with one extra check that the touch layer ends with `is-entering`. With the old guard put back, it fails with "HUD entry restarted: expected 0 to be greater than 0". With the fix, it passes. `pnpm typecheck` is clean and `pnpm test` passes: 108 files, 733 tests. I didn't run the screenshot capture, because the slide-in only shows as motion and a still screenshot can't show it restarting.
